parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL5162 (neuropeptide S receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5162' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
